details.title: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
details.governing_law: laws of the State of Texas

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

details.parties_quote:
This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of ____________, 2026 between:

**Sterling Care Network Inc.**, a Texas corporation having its principal office at 500 Main Street, Houston, Texas 77002 ("Sterling"); and

**AtliQ Inc**, a Delaware corporation having its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, New Jersey 08540 ("Vendor").

payment_source.quote: Sterling shall pay USD 270,000 in total in monthly instalments, within thirty (30) days of receipt of each invoice.

details.services_summary: Data engineering and analytics services to improve patient scheduling and clinic utilisation

liability_cap.basis: limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim
liability_cap.quote: Each party's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months before the claim.

insurance_requirements.quote: Vendor shall maintain, throughout the term, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 per claim.

titles: Health data but no BAA referenced
Cyber insurance of $5,000,000 required; AtliQ holds $1M

all_findings.title: Health data but no BAA referenced
all_findings.why: A HIPAA Business Associate Agreement is required before patient data moves.
all_findings.comparison: Healthcare deals need an NDA, a BAA and the services contract (CareBridge, Harrington).

all_findings.title: Cyber insurance of $5,000,000 required; AtliQ holds $1M
all_findings.why: AtliQ would be in breach on signing.
all_findings.quote: Vendor shall maintain, throughout the term, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 per claim.

all_findings.title: Confidentiality term longer than benchmark
all_findings.why: Longer than typical 6-12 month survival period in past contracts.
all_findings.comparison: Benchmark is 6 to 12 months; 3 years is an outlier.
all_findings.quote: survive for three (3) years after termination
